## KEY POINT

DXA is perhaps the best indirect method for assessing lean mass. Given its convenience and relatively low risk, it is a good option for estimating muscle development at the group level. Nevertheless, it is not sensitive to alterations in body water, and lacks the ability to detect subtle changes over the course of a regimented resistance training program. Ideally, it should be used in combination with site-specific measures to provide greater insights into muscle tissue composition (51).
